author: EmuCore - Hub
title: NetherSX2 Guide: PS2 Emulation on Android
summary: A detailed NetherSX2 Patch-versus-Classic guide that covers installation, quick configuration and migration from AetherSX2 while documenting later corrections.

blocks.text: Retro Game Corps explains the AetherSX2 lineage, why NetherSX2 has Patch and Classic variants, and why some games can favor the older Classic base. The tutorial builds and installs both paths, applies initial configuration, and demonstrates exporting and restoring data when moving from an existing AetherSX2 setup.

The video dates from March 2024, so its own description is essential: current NetherSX2 releases now include an APK, and the creator corrects the memory-card import step by specifying the main export folder rather than the memcard subfolder. Save-state compatibility is not a substitute for in-game saves. Use this for migration concepts, then follow the maintained release instructions for the current package.
